products.notes: Selected mobile boundary only. Coin98 Extension is a separate browser runtime and is deferred. Exact mobile launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: Coin98 Super Wallet V16 launch documented
events.description: Coin98 first-party June 2025 product sync states that Super Wallet V16 was officially launched during June, adding proactive wallet-risk and token-screening protections, trading improvements, and BOBA on-chain rewards. The publication does not establish an exact launch day in June, so this event is anchored to the dated first-party sync publication rather than inferring one.
